episode_title: BRICS Summit in India, Amazon Air Plane Crash, Federal Film Tax Bill
script_en: BRICS Summit in India, Amazon Air Plane Crash, Federal Film Tax Bill.
India hosts the 18th BRICS summit in New Delhi this weekend.
The crash of an Amazon cargo jet in Miami is raising concerns about the safety culture at the retail giant's air operations.
Congress weighs in on potential federal tax incentives to keep film production in the United States.
